description: Returns the signed-in account's plan and today's usage: Pro prompt access or Prompt Pack credits left, UI generations used and the daily limit, AnimatedWebs Design AI requests used and the daily limit, links to pricing, the UI library and Design, and a design section with the Design workspace URL. Set includeDesignConnect to true to also get ready-to-paste configuration for connecting the separate AnimatedWebs Design MCP server to Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code; that part contains a personal bearer token that opens the user's private workspace, so do not write it to shared files or repositories. Use this to check whether a Pro template, generate_component or refine_component call will succeed before making it, or to set up Design; use get_pricing for plan prices instead. Counts are per UTC day. Read-only; errors when not signed in.

includeDesignConnect.description: true adds design.connect (commands and config with a personal bearer token) and design.note. Default false keeps the token out of the reply.

name: get_account

plan.description: Plan id, e.g. free, starter, pro or lifetime

title: Get AnimatedWebs account
